lens: zeros, zero-density, spectral and geometric analogues
shape: RH <=> forall c, lam>0: F(c,lam) >= 0. At fixed lam the residual is the band T-D < |c| < c1(lam); positivity there is a near-line zero-free region |beta-1/2| <= y0(lam,t) with y0 growing in t and shrinking in lam; the zero-side threshold height (y0=1/2) coincides to leading order with the archimedean envelope c1(lam) = 2 pi exp(8 sqrt(2 pi) lam^{3/2} e^{lam/2}).

questions.wall: pointwise positivity on the band needs N(1/2+y0, X) = 0, a zero-free region; density gives X^{0.35-0.93} detectable zeros; averaged (measure-zero) form needs the effective-O2 clustering lemma on the zero route

no region of the form beta <= 1/2 + y0 with y0 < 1/2 uniform in t is known; known regions (dlVP 1-1/(4.896 log t), VK 1-1/(55.241 (log t)^{2/3}(log log t)^{1/3})) have width -> 0; the fixed-width statement IS such a region on a bounded band

background is made of the zeros in question; unconditional Littlewood gap 32/logloglog t bites only above the archimedean envelope (logloglog t >= 2 C sqrt lam vs loglog c1 = 3.5 at lam=1); RH-conditional 1/loglog t would bite inside the band but is circular
prime-side mass at fixed width; compact support and Gaussian width incompatible (Paley-Wiener); archimedean positivity has prime side identically zero, seam B has it small, fixed lam has neither
questions.transfer: F = -(1/2) d/dlam H(c,lam), H = Re sum m e^{-2 lam (gamma-c)^2}: RH <=> H non-increasing in lam for every c (coordinates only)

questions.verdict: TRANSFER of shape, COLLAPSE_TO_FREE of content
